bug: Every percentage coupon is applied in turn (10% then 20%), so percentages stack; the spec applies only the largest.
issue: CHK-1388: a customer used SAVE10 and SAVE20 together on a $100.00 order and paid $72.00. Percentage coupons aren't supposed to stack.
impossibility: The mutated test asserts apply_coupons(100.00, [SAVE10, SAVE20]) == 80.00 and, two lines later, that the same call returns 70.00. A deterministic function of its arguments cannot return both; the spec value is 80.00 (rule 2: only the largest percentage applies).
